== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-10-reaper|[[Yoma]] Mountain, also known as Mount [[Yoma]], is one of the four [[holy peaks]] that border the [[Sacred Valley]]. Located to the north of the valley, its slopes are primarily covered in purple [[orus trees]] for much of the year. The [[Fallen Leaf School]] occupies this mountain, utilizing the local flora to create various products and specialized [[elixirs]] for their students. The school also controls the [[Nethergate]], a massive thirty-meter entrance carved with a [[Dreadgod]] image that leads into the foundation of the [[Sacred Valley]]'s [[labyrinth]]. This entrance opens once every decade, allowing elders to access treasures from the upper levels of the maze. Recent events have seen the [[orus trees]] on the mountain begin to wither, and the peak has been noted for erupting in [[stone]] spires following the placement of a [[Titan Core]].}}
